steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Climate change is one of the greatest global challenges, caused by greenhouse gas emissions from burning fossil fuels. The Paris Agreement (2015) aims to limit warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels. | Key Fact: The UK has committed to net zero carbon emissions by 2050 — the first major economy to do so. This requires transforming energy, transport, and industry. The Climate Change Committee monitors progress. | Key Fact: Extreme poverty has declined globally but inequality persists both between and within nations. The richest 1% own nearly half the world's wealth.
